rationale: Manual human promotion decision (same convention as deployed_model_overall_single_v3/final_promotion_decision.json -- no automated run_benchmark/decide_promotion was used, that mechanism scores a legacy overall_label.grade against a baseline evaluator, not this architecture's single CORAL-head overall score). deberta_v3_base_overall_single_v5_1088_epoch8 (best epoch 8 of 8, selected by best validation QWK) was trained on overall_v5_1088 -- the frozen 1003-example four_dim_overall_v4_5000 dataset (702/150/151 split, unmodified) with the 85-example v5_short_quality_calibration_80 set appended to TRAIN ONLY (787/150/151 total). The 151-example test split and 150-example validation split are BYTE-IDENTICAL example_ids to the four_dim_overall_v4_5000 baseline used by deployed_model_overall_single_v3 -- verified by dataset_loader_v5.verify_dataset_integrity before training -- so the comparison below is apples-to-apples on the same held-out examples. Reported metrics: validation QWK 0.8643, test QWK 0.8529, test accuracy 0.6225, test within-1 accuracy 0.9735, test MAE 0.4040 (n=151). Improves on the currently-deployed deberta_v3_base_overall_single_v3_epoch6 (test QWK 0.6667, 220-example four_dim_experiment_v2 dataset) and on the intermediate, never-deployed deberta_v3_base_overall_single_v4_1003_epoch7 (test QWK 0.8451, 1003-example dataset, same 151 test ids). Approved for production deployment as the new Tier-1 evaluator; v3 remains fully intact as the Tier-2 rollback, A2 as Tier-3, bare HeuristicEvaluator as Tier-4 -- see deployed_model_overall_single_v5_1088/README.md for the full architecture and rollback discussion.
